## The claim

The missense allele of the leading pair falls inside an annotated InterPro domain, in a region the structure model is confident about, and the AlphaMissense class agrees that it is damaging.

**Prediction if true.** The residue maps inside at least one InterPro domain range of the gene canonical UniProt entry, the AlphaFold per-residue pLDDT at that position is 70 or above, and the AlphaMissense class recorded for the allele is likely_pathogenic.

**What would refute it.** The residue falls outside every annotated domain, or the pLDDT is below 70 so the model has no confident opinion there, or AlphaMissense does not call it likely_pathogenic. Any one of the three refutes the claim and is reported separately.
